doc_title: YouTube: Ornith 1.0 Beats Claude Opus 4.7 — and It's Free #aimodel #coding
title: Open-Source Model Release
content: Small models are shipped with MIT license. All uses, including commercial and fine-tuning, are allowed. No strings attached. Access it from ollama.com/library/ornith. Open weights now compete with Claude. Would you switch your daily driver to an open model or stick with a closed one? Let me know below.
raw_text: small one ships to you, and every size is MIT licensed. Commercial use, fine-tuning, all of it. No strings attached. Pull it from ollama.com/library/ornith. Open weights now trade blows with Claude. So, would you switch your daily driver to an open model or stay closed? Tell me below.
